sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P.
Counsel for Revisionist :- S.K. Yadav
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Aga
Hon'ble Sudhir Agarwal,J.
1.
None appeared to press this revision.
In the circumstances, I myself have perused the record.

2. This criminal revision under Section 397/401 Cr.P.C., has been filed aggrieved by judgement and order dated 08.09.1994 passed by Sri Sandhya Bhatt, XIIth Additional Sessions Judge, Varanasi in Criminal Appeal No. 99 of 1993, dismissing appeal and confirming the punishment imposed by Sri C.M. Tiwari, VIIth Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Varanasi vide judgment and order dated 10.12.1993, in Case No.746 of 1993, convicting revisionist under Section 7/16(1)(A)(i) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and sentencing to undergo six months simple imprisonment with fine of Rs. 1000/- and in default of payment of fine, he shall further suffer three months simple imprisonment.

procedural or otherwise, so as to justify interference in criminal revision.
Interim order, if any, stands vacated.
5. Certify this judgment to the lower Court immediately.
